name: Native article + related comment thread

sources.name: DTC native advertorial (editorial frame + social proof thread)
sources.note: Industry uses comment-style proof; many live examples are deceptive. This skeleton keeps the layout, requires Advertisement disclosure, forbids fake experts/publications, and constrains comments to non-claim opinion or verified/attributed lines.

components.hint: Real tenant author from authors.yaml — never invent a fake journalist or publication
Problem-led opening; product not named in first beat
Numbered article beats that earn the product turn by midpoint
3-5 fake-layout comments that relate to article beats — see compliance

reasons.heading_hint: What actually has to be true (mechanism)
First clear product turn with verified facts
What daily use looks like — no unsourced outcome promises

comments.fill_policy: question only; no invented specs in the question
verified claim_ids only if stating a fact

notes: ALWAYS show Advertisement label; this is paid content.
Do NOT invent a publication name, fake reporter, or unverifiable expert.
Comment author display names are layout placeholders only — not real people unless facts_pack provides them.
Comments must not smuggle unsourced stats, medical claims, or review counts.
Prefer omitting a comment over inventing proof.

reason_fills: What full-spectrum + red light is actually doing (verified)
Peak Mini / model turn with plug-and-play
A realistic daily rhythm — no miracle claims

peak_saunas.comments_note: Render comments as a labeled 'Reader discussion (illustrative)' block in future template work; for JSON today, put comment texts into reasons' attributed customer lines or closing paragraphs only if policy allows — skeleton documents the intended layout.

writer_brief: Write a short native article that earns a product turn by reason 4. Include a comments slot plan in closing.paragraphs only as clearly labeled illustrative discussion if the schema has no comments field yet — never fake experts. Keep density short.
